# An allocation regression too small for the loose TIMING gate but well above
# the tight ALLOCATION gate. Proves the two thresholds are applied per metric
# class: at a single 50% gate this table would pass unflagged.

                       │  allocs/op    │  allocs/op     vs base              │

                       │     B/op      │     B/op       vs base              │
